name: vultax-research
description: Search and cite published crypto and prediction-market research, then retrieve its tables and datasets.

interface.shortDescription: Crypto and prediction-market studies with sources and data.
interface.longDescription: Find Vultax's published studies on Polymarket traders, copy-trading costs, market liquidity, exchange feed latency and trading activity. Read complete articles and retrieve published tables and charts with source URLs, dates, units, observation context and CSV/JSON downloads. Free public research; no account or API key required. Study snapshots and calculations are not live quotes or personalized investment advice. The plugin cannot access accounts or execute trades.
defaultPrompt: Find Vultax research on Polymarket copy-trading costs.
Compare the evidence on profitable trader persistence.
Get the published exchange feed-latency dataset.
